# Star-Rated Source Check - 2026-05-24

Current GitHub star counts were checked on 2026-05-24 through the GitHub API.

| Source | Repo | Stars | V2 Usage |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| GitHub Spec Kit | `github/spec-kit` | 105,380 | Primary PRD/spec, plan, task, and checklist structure |
| Best README Template | `othneildrew/Best-README-Template` | 16,081 | Optional README/repo packaging source |
| MADR | `adr/madr` | 2,218 | Architecture decision record source |
| arc42 Template | `arc42/arc42-template` | 1,218 | TRD, architecture, and backend design source |
| Opulo PRD Template | `opulo-inc/prd-template` | 25 | Secondary PRD wording reference only |

## Decision

Use Spec Kit as the canonical requirements and implementation workflow source
for V2 trading. Use arc42 and MADR to strengthen technical architecture,
backend schema, and decision tracking. Keep the Opulo PRD template only as a
downloaded PRD reference because it is not top-starred.
